name: Clothing Product Automation v2 - imgbb Fix

parameters.body:
={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 1000,
  "temperature": 0.2,
  "system": "You are a fashion attribute extraction engine. Inspect the garment in the provided images and return ONLY valid JSON.

Fields:
- primary_color, secondary_colors[]
- pattern: Solid|Striped|Checked|Printed|Graphic|Floral|Color-block|Embroidered|Tie-dye|Abstract|Other
- fabric_guess: Cotton|Polyester|Denim|Linen|Wool|Blend|Knit|Fleece|Viscose|etc
- fit: Slim|Regular|Relaxed|Oversized|Loose|Skinny|Straight|Tapered
- sleeve_length: Sleeveless|Short|Half|Three-quarter|Full|N/A
- neckline: Crew|V-neck|Polo|Collared|Round|Boat|Henley|Mandarin|Hooded|N/A
- length: Cropped|Regular|Long|Knee|Midi|Maxi|Above-knee|Ankle|N/A
- closure: Pullover|Button|Zip|Drawstring|Elastic|Hook|N/A
- design_details: array of notable details
- occasion: array from [Casual,Formal,Semi-formal,Party,Sports,Festive,Daily,Loungewear]
- season: array from [Summer,Winter,Monsoon,All-season]

Do not invent details not visible. Return ONLY valid JSON.",
  "messages": [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": [
      {"type": "image", "source": {"type": "url", "url": "={{ $node["Code - Store Image URLs"].json.front_image_url }}"}},
      {"type": "image", "source": {"type": "url", "url": "={{ $node["Code - Store Image URLs"].json.back_image_url }}"}},
      {"type": "text", "text": "={{ "Classification: " + JSON.stringify($node["Code - Store Image URLs"].json.classification) }}"}
    ]
  }]
}

={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 1000,
  "temperature": 0.6,
  "system": "You are an e-commerce copywriter. Return ONLY valid JSON.

Produce:
- title: 60-80 chars. Formula: [Gender] + [Color] + [Pattern/Style] + [Subcategory]. No brand name.
- short_description: ONE punchy sentence, 120-160 chars, benefit-led, no cliches.
- long_description: 80-120 words. Fabric feel, fit, styling occasions, key design details. No filler phrases.
- bullet_highlights: exactly 5 bullets, max 8 words each — fit, fabric, design, occasion, care.

Tone: clean, modern, confident, factual. No superlatives. No emoji.

Schema: {"title":"","short_description":"","long_description":"","bullet_highlights":["","","","",""]}",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "={{ "Classification: " + JSON.stringify($node["Code - Parse B2"].json.classification) + "\nAttributes: " + JSON.stringify($node["Code - Parse B2"].json.attributes) }}"}]
}

={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 1000,
  "temperature": 0.2,
  "system": "You are a product variant mapper. Return ONLY valid JSON.

Sizing rules:
- Adult Topwear/Dress/Outerwear: ["XS","S","M","L","XL","XXL"]
- Adult Bottomwear rigid (jeans/chinos): ["28","30","32","34","36","38","40"]
- Adult Bottomwear elastic (joggers/tracks): ["S","M","L","XL","XXL"]
- Kids (4-7): ["4Y","5Y","6Y","7Y"]
- Kids (8-12): ["8Y","9Y","10Y","11Y","12Y"]
- Footwear: return empty available_sizes

Color variants: detected primary color first, then 3-5 common alternates realistic for this garment.

Output: {"available_sizes":[],"color_variants":[],"size_chart_type":"","default_variant":{"size":"","color":""}}",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "={{ "Classification: " + JSON.stringify($node["Code - Parse B3"].json.classification) + "\nAttributes: " + JSON.stringify($node["Code - Parse B3"].json.attributes) }}"}]
}

={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 1000,
  "temperature": 0.6,
  "system": "You are an SEO specialist for e-commerce fashion. Return ONLY valid JSON.

Fields:
- meta_title: 50-60 chars, primary keyword + gender + category
- meta_description: 150-160 chars, 2 keywords naturally, ends with soft CTA
- focus_keyword: ONE phrase, 2-4 words
- secondary_keywords: 5-8 related terms, mix short + long-tail
- tags: 10-15 short tags for filtering/discovery
- alt_text_front: under 125 chars, gender + color + garment
- alt_text_side: descriptive alt for side image
- alt_text_back: descriptive alt for back image
- url_slug: lowercase, hyphenated, max 60 chars

No keyword stuffing. All copy reads naturally.",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "={{ "Classification: " + JSON.stringify($node["Code - Parse B4"].json.classification) + "\nAttributes: " + JSON.stringify($node["Code - Parse B4"].json.attributes) + "\nContent: " + JSON.stringify($node["Code - Parse B4"].json.content) }}"}]
}

={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 1000,
  "temperature": 0.2,
  "system": "You are a data formatter. Merge all provided JSON inputs into one clean validated product record. Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown, no commentary.

Rules:
- Preserve all data exactly. Do not rewrite or invent.
- If any field is missing, set it to null.
- Match the output schema exactly.

Schema:
{
  "product_id": "",
  "created_at": "",
  "source_image": "",
  "classification": {},
  "attributes": {},
  "content": {},
  "variants": {},
  "seo": {},
  "images": {"front":"","side":"","back":""}
}",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "={{ "B1: " + JSON.stringify($node["Code - Parse B5"].json.classification) + "\nB2: " + JSON.stringify($node["Code - Parse B5"].json.attributes) + "\nB3: " + JSON.stringify($node["Code - Parse B5"].json.content) + "\nB4: " + JSON.stringify($node["Code - Parse B5"].json.variants) + "\nB5: " + JSON.stringify($node["Code - Parse B5"].json.seo) }}"}]
}

meta.notes:
SETUP BEFORE RUNNING:
1. ENV VARS in n8n Settings > Environment Variables:
   ANTHROPIC_API_KEY     - Anthropic API key
   HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY    - Higgsfield API key
   HIGGSFIELD_GENERATION_ENDPOINT - Higgsfield image gen REST URL (get from their docs)
   IMGBB_API_KEY         - Free key from imgbb.com/api
   OUTPUT_FOLDER_ID      - Google Drive folder ID for output files
2. Replace REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_DRIVE_CREDENTIAL_ID in both Drive nodes
3. Webhook POST body: { image_url, file_id, gender_hint }
   image_url  = publicly accessible URL of the garment photo
   file_id    = Google Drive file ID for binary upload to imgbb
   gender_hint = Men | Women | Boys | Girls
4. The imgbb node replaced the old 3-step Higgsfield upload.
   imgbb hosts the image publicly; Higgsfield accepts the URL directly.
